Refuse to fabricate exact error text. What'd settle it: grep sqlpipe source (`grep -rn "PutObject\|AccessDenied" .` in repo) or check GitHub repo `sqlpipe/sqlpipe`. Give me repo path or I pull via WebFetch if you confirm URL.
